PNG timings measure one automated local export, not a real participant task time.
No human participants or before/after study results are claimed.

Browser performance measured separately on a stable production build.
Lab measurements, not field percentiles or real-device results. Full maps/claim preparation measured separately; participant card timing not inferred.
